name: India
notes: Depth: seed. Scope: the Union level in every layer reached by web search (think tank and economists behind the 2024 World Inequality Lab proposal, CPI(M) and CPI manifestos, Oxfam India, the Centre for Financial Accountability and Tax the Top campaign, two economists, one Congress leader, the 2020 revenue officers' paper), the 36 states and union territories and 726 districts as a register. First pass R001 (2026-10-20), English-language sources only. Not done: Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha records, Hindi and regional-language sources, state assemblies, unions, most media and economists, the Tax the Top partner list (its site was unreachable), municipal bodies. The district map uses an unofficial compilation (see boundaries.json source) with project-assigned district codes.
